evaluation_scope.claim_boundary: Fixture-backed comparative evidence only; not a live LLM benchmark or production retain metric.
expected_outcome_signal: The current skill-refiner path blocks continuation without a problem card and next-cut reason.
The current path defers create, split, rewrite, and optimize decisions until SR-F1.
The current path proves all ten refinement rings before one-shot execution.
The current path records and resolves conclusion drift with supersedes before SR-F1.
The current path proves all-ring external best-practice source coverage for a real external-practice Skill shadow run.

scenarios.small_requirement: Continue polishing skill-refiner after user feedback without drifting into opportunistic edits.
scenarios.failure_mode: A legacy path could keep editing after one ring because the next cut was not framed as a consumer-backed problem.

best_practice_evidence.evidence: The problem card requires next_cut_reason, quality dimension, consumer, change scope, verification, counter-evidence, and stop condition before edits.
The completion gate test rejects result JSON without problem_cards and rejects problem cards that point at PASS or unexecuted scopes.
The validator checks non-PASS candidate strategy change_scope and problem_card change_scope against executed files.

blocked_failure_modes: continue without next-cut reason
claim a problem card for a PASS ring
claim a change scope that was not executed
current.evidence_summary: Current evidence ties the next polishing move to problem_cards and validator-backed executed scope.

blocked_failure_modes: direct edit after a single ring
self-certified completion without executed-scope proof
baseline.evidence_summary: The baseline behavior is represented by negative fixtures: without these anchors the gate rejects completion evidence.

scenarios.verdict: Current path wins because it turns continue-polishing into a problem-card decision before any edit.

scenarios.small_requirement: Handle a request that appears to need a new code-review Skill.
scenarios.failure_mode: A legacy path could create immediately instead of locating existing review capability and freezing final operation at SR-F1.

best_practice_evidence.evidence: The output asks to locate existing review capability before proposing any new Skill.
The trace records every SR step and freezes final_operation=optimize only at SR-F1.
The self-dogfood test verifies input defect, output behavior, full SR trace, result JSON, and run-all registration.

blocked_failure_modes: immediate create decision
file write before SR-F1
new Skill proposal without capability lookup
current.evidence_summary: Current evidence optimizes the existing tiny-review-router and proves create is only a final-operation candidate before SR-F1.

blocked_failure_modes: Final decision: create a new code-review Skill immediately.
baseline.evidence_summary: The baseline input contains the immediate-create defect that the self-dogfood output removes.

scenarios.verdict: Current path wins because final operation is frozen after all rings instead of guessed at trigger time.

scenarios.small_requirement: Refine a noisy implementation Skill into a low-noise professional development SOP.
scenarios.failure_mode: A legacy path could fix only the SOP text and skip resource, eval, cleanup, runtime, and one-shot execution proof.

best_practice_evidence.evidence: The dogfood result records real scenario, business constraint, expected outcome signal, observed pain, protected capability candidate, entry point candidate, located carrier, and open questions.
The result covers Trigger through Runtime with PASS, ISSUE_FIXED, or BLOCKED evidence before completion.
Anchor fidelity records 12 of 12 expected anchors passed.

blocked_failure_modes: single-ring SOP-only cleanup
old test preserved as target behavior
completion without scoped validation
current.evidence_summary: Current dogfood evidence proves every ring, fixture output, anchor fidelity, and scoped validation path.

blocked_failure_modes: runtime field noise remains in main SOP
old noisy contract remains active
baseline.evidence_summary: The baseline fixture keeps noisy runtime teaching and the old test that the refined output replaces.

scenarios.verdict: Current path wins because the complete ring sequence and scoped validator prove the refined Skill is not just a single SOP patch.

scenarios.small_requirement: Reject a later-ring create drift after the baseline confirmed optimize-only behavior.
scenarios.failure_mode: A legacy path could silently mutate an earlier optimize conclusion into create during Flow or SR-F1.

best_practice_evidence.evidence: The transcript records that SR-R4 proposed final_operation=create against the SR-S2 optimize-only baseline.
The ledger contains supersedes[0] with proposed_operation=create, resolved_operation=optimize, and status=resolved_by_user_confirmation.
The test requires the transcript to state that the run stopped for user decision before target file changes.
The result freezes strategy_freeze.final_operation=optimize and links to the resolved ledger checkpoint.

blocked_failure_modes: silent create drift after optimize baseline
target file edit before user resolves conflict
SR-F1 freeze based on unresolved drift
current.evidence_summary: Current evidence records the create drift in supersedes, pauses for user confirmation, and freezes optimize after resolution.

blocked_failure_modes: text rule exists but no dedicated drift fixture proves it
later-ring create could look like a legitimate final operation without explicit supersedes evidence
baseline.evidence_summary: The baseline is represented by the absence of a dedicated drift fixture; the new gate fails if the evidence disappears.

scenarios.verdict: Current path wins because conclusion drift is now persisted, paused, resolved, and tied to the final optimize checkpoint.

scenarios.small_requirement: Pressure-test github-repo-radar shadow refinement against official, GitHub, and community best-practice sources across every ring.
scenarios.failure_mode: A legacy path could only research Flow or rely on local context, leaving other rings shallow and unverifiable.

best_practice_evidence.evidence: The result requires every ring_blueprint to include official, github, and community source_type entries.
The audit records GitHub Docs, github/docs source, OpenSSF Scorecard, CHAOSS metrics, and Linux Foundation sources with usage notes.
The ledger ring_sources record source_conflicts that Scorecard totals and popularity signals are not single verdicts.
The test requires the transcript to state that no production github-repo-radar file was modified in the shadow run.

blocked_failure_modes: Flow-only best-practice research
local-only source evidence for an external repository evaluation Skill
Scorecard or stars treated as a single verdict
current.evidence_summary: Current evidence proves all ten rings consume official, GitHub, and community sources with a source audit and shadow-only boundary.

blocked_failure_modes: target Skill has a good local rubric but no skill-refiner shadow evidence that every ring researches external practices
external-source depth could regress without a dedicated gate
baseline.evidence_summary: The baseline local Skill and rubric do not prove skill-refiner can enforce all-ring external-practice research depth.

scenarios.verdict: Current path wins because the github-repo-radar shadow run turns external best-practice depth into a verifiable all-ring contract.
